claims.claim:
Tech Times 자료의 원문 인용(발표 내용): 「On the hardware side, Robros uses a low reduction ratio drive system with torque-based control. This is a specific
architectural choice with a specific tradeoff. Higher gear reduction ratios (50:1 to 100:1) found in typical collaborative
robots make joints safer and more controllable at slow speeds — but they reduce the actuator's ability to respond quickly
to disturbances. IGRIS-C's lower reduction ratio (reported at 30:1 per Aparobot) delivers what Robros calls "high torque
transmission," with a maximum joint torque of 150 newton-meters. The tradeoff: the robot responds faster to control
commands and absorbs physical shocks more readily — which is what a backflip requires — but the architecture
demands a more sophisticated control system to maintain stability at rest.」
claims.source_bound_quote:
On the hardware side, Robros uses a low reduction ratio drive system with torque-based control. This is a specific
architectural choice with a specific tradeoff. Higher gear reduction ratios (50:1 to 100:1) found in typical collaborative
robots make joints safer and more controllable at slow speeds — but they reduce the actuator's ability to respond quickly
to disturbances. IGRIS-C's lower reduction ratio (reported at 30:1 per Aparobot) delivers what Robros calls "high torque
transmission," with a maximum joint torque of 150 newton-meters. The tradeoff: the robot responds faster to control
commands and absorbs physical shocks more readily — which is what a backflip requires — but the architecture
demands a more sophisticated control system to maintain stability at rest.

claims.claim:
Tech Times 자료의 원문 인용(발표 내용): 「On the learning side, Robros uses two different methodologies for two different problems. Reinforcement learning (RL)
trains the bipedal walking and whole-body control policies: a simulated robot learns through reward signals,
with policies then transferred to the physical hardware (the sim-to-real approach). Imitation learning (IL) handles
manipulation tasks: human operators drive the robot via a "master hand" interface, collecting demonstrations that train
the robot to reproduce the same task in similar environments. The combination — RL for locomotion, IL for manipulation
— is now standard among advanced humanoid developers. It is the architecture that allows the same platform to walk
dynamically and handle objects precisely, without requiring one subsystem to solve both problems.」
claims.source_bound_quote:
On the learning side, Robros uses two different methodologies for two different problems. Reinforcement learning (RL)
trains the bipedal walking and whole-body control policies: a simulated robot learns through reward signals,
with policies then transferred to the physical hardware (the sim-to-real approach). Imitation learning (IL) handles
manipulation tasks: human operators drive the robot via a "master hand" interface, collecting demonstrations that train
the robot to reproduce the same task in similar environments. The combination — RL for locomotion, IL for manipulation
— is now standard among advanced humanoid developers. It is the architecture that allows the same platform to walk
dynamically and handle objects precisely, without requiring one subsystem to solve both problems.

claims.claim:
Tech Times 자료의 원문 인용(발표 내용): 「The hands themselves reflect the same design logic. Each hand uses a tendon-driven structure — actuators and
joints connected by wires — delivering six active degrees of freedom per hand and a total of 11 including
passive degrees of freedom. The result: each hand weighs approximately 300 grams (10.6 oz) with a per-hand payload
capacity of 3 kilograms (6.6 lbs). Lightweight hands on a humanoid matter because the robot's arms act as long lever
arms — excess mass at the end of the arm increases the torque the shoulder joint must manage. The tendon-driven
architecture trades some mechanical complexity for substantially reduced distal mass, which simplifies the stability
problem for the whole-body controller.」
claims.source_bound_quote:
The hands themselves reflect the same design logic. Each hand uses a tendon-driven structure — actuators and

claims.claim:
Tech Times 자료의 원문 인용(발표 내용): 「The frame of comparison that Robros invites is with Boston Dynamics' Atlas and with Chinese systems. Boston
Dynamics has long been the reference for what a humanoid can do physically; the RAI Institute, led by Boston Dynamics
founder Marc Raibert, has described its platform as producing gymnastic maneuvers and natural walking gait from the
same learning framework — a unified whole-body approach that allows control policies trained in simulation to run
on physical hardware without additional tuning. The key point: the same underlying learning architecture produces
both a backflip and a walking gait. IGRIS-C's claim is to have reached that same architectural capability through an
entirely domestic engineering effort.」

claims.claim:
Tech Times 자료의 원문 인용(발표 내용): 「On the Chinese side, the reference event is Unitree Robotics' performance at China's 2026 Spring Festival Gala on
February 17, 2026, where G1 and H2 machines executed complex martial arts routines including the world's first
continuous freestyle table-vaulting parkour, an aerial flip with a maximum height approaching approximately 10
feet (3 meters), and a two-step wall-assisted backflip. Those demonstrations established the benchmark that any
serious humanoid must now clear to be taken seriously on dynamic motion.
Robros cleared it six months later, with hardware built in Seoul.」

claims.claim:
Tech Times 자료의 원문 인용(발표 내용): 「On the hardware side, Robros uses a low reduction ratio drive system with torque-based control. This is a specific
architectural choice with a specific tradeoff. Higher gear reduction ratios (50:1 to 100:1) found in typical collaborative
robots make joints safer and more controllable at slow speeds — but they reduce the actuator's ability to respond quickly
to disturbances. IGRIS-C's lower reduction ratio (reported at 30:1 per Aparobot) delivers what Robros calls "high torque
transmission," with a maximum joint torque of 150 newton-meters. The tradeoff: the robot responds faster to control
commands and absorbs physical shocks more readily — which is what a backflip requires — but the architecture
demands a more sophisticated control system to maintain stability at rest.」
claims.source_bound_quote:

robots make joints safer and more controllable at slow speeds — but they reduce the actuator's ability to respond quickly
to disturbances. IGRIS-C's lower reduction ratio (reported at 30:1 per Aparobot) delivers what Robros calls "high torque
transmission," with a maximum joint torque of 150 newton-meters. The tradeoff: the robot responds faster to control
commands and absorbs physical shocks more readily — which is what a backflip requires — but the architecture
demands a more sophisticated control system to maintain stability at rest.

claims.claim:
Tech Times 자료의 원문 인용(발표 내용): 「On the learning side, Robros uses two different methodologies for two different problems. Reinforcement learning (RL)
trains the bipedal walking and whole-body control policies: a simulated robot learns through reward signals,
with policies then transferred to the physical hardware (the sim-to-real approach). Imitation learning (IL) handles
manipulation tasks: human operators drive the robot via a "master hand" interface, collecting demonstrations that train
the robot to reproduce the same task in similar environments. The combination — RL for locomotion, IL for manipulation
— is now standard among advanced humanoid developers. It is the architecture that allows the same platform to walk
dynamically and handle objects precisely, without requiring one subsystem to solve both problems.」
claims.source_bound_quote:

manipulation tasks: human operators drive the robot via a "master hand" interface, collecting demonstrations that train

claims.claim:
Tech Times 자료의 원문 인용(발표 내용): 「The hands themselves reflect the same design logic. Each hand uses a tendon-driven structure — actuators and
joints connected by wires — delivering six active degrees of freedom per hand and a total of 11 including
passive degrees of freedom. The result: each hand weighs approximately 300 grams (10.6 oz) with a per-hand payload
capacity of 3 kilograms (6.6 lbs). Lightweight hands on a humanoid matter because the robot's arms act as long lever
arms — excess mass at the end of the arm increases the torque the shoulder joint must manage. The tendon-driven
architecture trades some mechanical complexity for substantially reduced distal mass, which simplifies the stability
problem for the whole-body controller.」

### 최종 투자 제안
**투자 보류** — 확인된 투자 포인트가 있으나 현재의 위험·미확인 사항을 고려한 종합 의견은 보류다.

종합 의견의 이유: 로브로스는 2020년 설립 이후 자체 개발 휴머노이드 로봇 IGRIS-C를 중심으로 제조, 물류, 반도체 등 다양한 산업 현장에 실증을 확대하며, 국내외 다수 프로젝트 선정 및 벤처투자 유치, 기술 역량과 독자적인 AI·하드웨어 개발 능력 등을 바탕으로 긍정적인 성장 잠재력을 보이고 있습니다. 다수 대학과 기업에서 PoC(개념 증명) 단계를 진행하며 제품 적용 사례가 존재하고, 시장 성장 환경 역시 양호하나, 반복적 대량 상용화 실적, 구체적인 매출 성장 및 현장 안정성에 대한 독립 검증된 데이터가 부족합니다. 또한, 조직 운영 체계 명확성, 투자조건, 장기 고객 확보 및 유지, 경쟁우위의 확실성 등 다수 핵심 항목이 확인되지 않아 현 시점에서 투자 판단을 내리기에는 불확실성이 큽니다. 따라서 추가적인 실증 데이터, 재무 및 계약 문서, 고객 확보 및 유지 실적, 운영 체계 검증 자료 확보 후 재검토가 필요합니다.

### 왜 이 기업을 검토하는가

- 제품화·사업 실행력: 로브로스(Robros) 자료의 원문 인용(발표 내용): 「작은 설계와 실험에서 출발해, 제품을 만들고 현장에 적용하며 산업으로 확장 해왔습니다.」 [E11]

- 소통의 명확성과 신뢰성: 로브로스(Robros) 자료의 원문 인용(발표 내용): 「No technical documents.」 [E80]

- 실제 접근 가능한 시장: 로브로스(Robros) 자료의 원문 인용(발표 내용): 「수서 ICT ∙ 동해휴게소 무인 로봇 카페 운영 2021 화성휴게소 ∙ 장흥정남진휴게소 무인 로봇 카페 운영」 [E105]

- 핵심 작업 성능: U로 판단을 유보한다. 실제 실패·부재의 증거는 아니다.

- 현장 안정성·안전성: U로 판단을 유보한다. 실제 실패·부재의 증거는 아니다.

- 유상 매출·납품: U로 판단을 유보한다. 실제 실패·부재의 증거는 아니다.

### 투자 전 필수 조건

- 현재 투자조건: 현재 거래의 기업가치·지분/권리·자금 사용 계획 확인

rubric.groundedness_reason: 모든 평가 항목과 각 문단의 기업 사실, 등급 산정 및 결론, 그리고 판정 사유가 해당 문단의 allowed_facts와 실제 원문 페이지에서 확인된 인용 사실에 의해 직접적으로 지지되고 있다. 보고서 내 반복 매출, 정량 KPI, 거래단계 확대 속성의 임의 단정이나 과장도 허용 범위 내 제한적 추론(실증이 반복적 유상 납품, 반복매출 실적으로 단정되지 않음)으로 일관되게 구분하고, 'U' 표시는 실제 미확인임을 투명하게 기록한다.
rubric.neutrality_reason: 경쟁력, 수상 실적, 시장 접근 등 모든 설명에서 홍보적 언어(예: 우수성·확실성 단정)를 실적·기술·계획 또는 가능성 수준에 따라 명확히 구분하여 기술하고 있다. 자료 미확인은 실제 부재·실패 주장으로 변환하지 않고, ‘경쟁력’, ‘차별성’ 등도 실측/반복/확장 근거 없는 경우 직접 단정하지 않음. 자체 발표 및 언론 발표 내용은 독립 검증과 구분해 설명하며, 조건부 추론은 한계와 후속 확인 필요성을 명확하게 병기하고 있다.
rubric.bias_control_reason: 대부분의 주요 실적·성과·특허 등 기업 발표임을 정확히 명기하고, 외부 독립 검증이 없거나 반복/장기 매출·배치·고객 유지·시장 확대 등 평가 항목이 자료로 미확인된 경우 이를 ‘U’로 투명하게 표기하고, 필요한 추가자료와 한계를 후속 확인 안내로 정직하게 기재한다. 대기업·투자자·계약 단계 역시 원문 근거와 등급 부합 여부를 명확히 구분하고, 미확정 투자조건이나 미확인 매출, 반복 실적을 임의로 확대하지 않는다.
